definitions.explanation: A word opposite in meaning to another — the standard term for an antonym (e.g., {高|たか}い vs {低|ひく}い). The opposite concept is {類義語|るいぎご} (synonym, near-synonym).

examples.japanese: 「⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{対義語|たいぎご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧」だ。
{対義語|たいぎご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{語彙|ごい}→語彙：14214_goi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。

⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{対義語|たいぎご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{答|こた}える→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The test had questions asking for the antonyms of words.

notes:
A grammar and vocabulary term used in language study.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{反対語|はんたいご}→反対語：29409_hantaigo⟧: antonym — an everyday synonym of {対義語|たいぎご}
- ⟦{類義語|るいぎご}→類義語：15939_ruigigo⟧: synonym, near-synonym — the opposite concept
- ⟦{同義語|どうぎご}→同義語：26263_dougigo⟧: synonym (identical meaning)
